source_text:
Recipe text（提取并整理后的流程文字）
1. 抹茶海绵蛋糕胚
黄油、抹茶粉和牛奶隔水加热融化，搅拌均匀后放凉备用。蛋黄加入细砂糖 B，打发至发白膨胀且纹路持久不消散。蛋白加入细砂糖 A，分三次打发至硬性发泡、形成直立尖角。
将蛋白霜分三次以翻拌方式加入蛋黄糊中。筛入低筋面粉，翻拌至无干粉。取少量面糊与抹茶黄油液混合，再倒回主面糊中翻拌均匀。倒入模具并震出气泡。烤箱预热至 160°C，烘烤约 40 分钟。出炉后倒扣，彻底放凉后脱模。
2. 抹茶烤芝士层
抹茶粉加入少量牛奶化开。奶油奶酪室温软化，加入糖搅打至顺滑。全蛋液分三次加入，每次搅拌均匀。加入抹茶牛奶液和低筋面粉，搅拌均匀，然后整体过筛两遍。
将海绵蛋糕胚切成约 1.5 cm 厚，放入模具底部。倒入芝士糊并震出气泡。以 160°C 烘烤 25–30 分钟，取出自然放凉。
3. 芝士慕斯层
吉利丁片用冷水泡软并挤干。牛奶、蛋黄和糖隔水加热至微烫，放凉后加入吉利丁，搅拌至融化。
将马斯卡彭搅拌至顺滑，分次加入蛋黄牛奶液并混合均匀，再加入淡奶油搅匀。倒在已经冷却的烤芝士层上，震平，冷藏 至少 4 小时，隔夜口感更佳。
English process
Matcha sponge:
melt butter with matcha and milk → cool → add sugar to egg yolks → whip yolks until pale and fluffy → gradually add sugar to egg whites → whip to stiff peaks → fold egg whites into yolk mixture → sift in cake flour → fold → combine a small amount of batter with matcha-butter mixture → return mixture to main batter → fold → pour into mold → remove air bubbles → bake at 160°C for 40 minutes → invert → cool → unmold
Baked matcha cheesecake:
dissolve matcha in milk → soften cream cheese → add sugar → mix until smooth → gradually add beaten egg → mix → add matcha-milk mixture → add cake flour → mix → strain twice → slice sponge cake → place sponge in mold → pour cheesecake batter → remove air bubbles → bake at 160°C for 25–30 minutes → cool
Mascarpone mousse:
soak gelatin in cold water → squeeze dry → combine milk, egg yolk, and sugar → heat over a water bath → cool slightly → add gelatin → dissolve → smooth mascarpone → gradually add yolk-milk mixture → mix → add heavy cream → mix → pour mousse over baked cheesecake layer → level → refrigerate for at least 4 hours → finish

text_steps.text: 黄油、抹茶粉和牛奶隔水加热融化，
text_steps.text_en: Melt the butter, matcha powder, and milk over a water bath.
Stir until evenly combined.
Leave it to cool for later use.
Add fine sugar B to the egg yolks.

text_steps.text: 打发至发白膨胀且纹路持久不消散。
text_steps.text_en: Whip the yolks until pale and expanded, with trails that persist.
Add fine sugar A to the egg whites.

text_steps.text: 分三次打发至硬性发泡、形成直立尖角。
text_steps.text_en: Whip the egg whites with the sugar in the first of three whipping stages.

text_steps.text: 分三次打发至硬性发泡、形成直立尖角。
text_steps.text_en: Continue whipping the egg whites in the second of three stages.

text_steps.text: 分三次打发至硬性发泡、形成直立尖角。
text_steps.text_en: Whip the egg whites in the third stage until stiff peaks form and stand upright.
Divide the egg-white foam into three portions.

text_steps.text: 将蛋白霜分三次以翻拌方式加入蛋黄糊中。
text_steps.text_en: Add the first portion of the egg-white foam to the yolk mixture.

text_steps.text: 以翻拌方式加入蛋黄糊中。
text_steps.text_en: Fold the egg-white foam into the yolk mixture after the first addition.

text_steps.text: 将蛋白霜分三次以翻拌方式加入蛋黄糊中。
text_steps.text_en: Add the second portion of the egg-white foam to the yolk mixture.

text_steps.text: 以翻拌方式加入蛋黄糊中。
text_steps.text_en: Fold the egg-white foam into the yolk mixture after the second addition.

text_steps.text: 将蛋白霜分三次以翻拌方式加入蛋黄糊中。
text_steps.text_en: Add the remaining portion of the egg-white foam to the yolk mixture.

text_steps.text: 以翻拌方式加入蛋黄糊中。
text_steps.text_en: Fold the egg-white foam into the yolk mixture after the last addition.
Sift in the cake flour.
Fold until no dry flour remains.
Take a small portion of the batter.

text_steps.text: 取少量面糊与抹茶黄油液混合，
text_steps.text_en: Combine the small portion of batter with the matcha-butter liquid.
Mix it with the matcha-butter liquid.
Pour the mixture back into the main batter.
Fold until evenly combined.
Pour into a mold and shake out the air bubbles.
Preheat the oven to 160°C.
Bake for about 40 minutes.
After removing it from the oven, invert it.
Let it cool completely.
Remove it from the mold.
Add matcha powder to a small amount of milk.
Stir to dissolve the matcha.
Soften the cream cheese at room temperature.
Add sugar to the cream cheese.
Beat until smooth.
Divide the beaten whole egg into three portions.
Add the first portion of the beaten egg to the cream cheese mixture.
Stir until evenly combined after the first addition.
Add the second portion of the beaten egg to the cream cheese mixture.
Stir until evenly combined after the second addition.
Add the last portion of the beaten egg to the cream cheese mixture.
Stir until evenly combined after the last addition.
Add the matcha-milk liquid.
Add the cake flour.
Stir until evenly combined.
Then strain the entire mixture twice.

text_steps.text: 将海绵蛋糕胚切成约 1.5 cm 厚，
text_steps.text_en: Cut the sponge cake base into slices about 1.5 cm thick.
Place the sponge cake at the bottom of the mold.
Pour in the cheesecake batter.
Shake out the air bubbles.
Bake at 160°C for 25–30 minutes.
Take it out and let it cool naturally.
Use cold water to soak the gelatin sheets until soft.
Soak the gelatin sheets in cold water until soft.
Squeeze the gelatin dry.

text_steps.text: 牛奶、蛋黄和糖隔水加热至微烫，
text_steps.text_en: Heat the milk, egg yolks, and sugar over a water bath until slightly hot.
Let the heated mixture cool.
Add the gelatin to the cooled mixture.
Stir until the gelatin dissolves.

text_steps.text: 将马斯卡彭搅拌至顺滑，
text_steps.text_en: Stir the mascarpone until smooth.
Add the yolk-milk liquid in batches.
Mix until evenly combined.
Then add the heavy cream.
Stir until evenly combined.

text_steps.text: 倒在已经冷却的烤芝士层上，
text_steps.text_en: Pour the mousse over the cooled baked cheesecake layer.
Shake it level.

text_steps.text: 冷藏 至少 4 小时，
text_steps.text_en: Refrigerate for at least 4 hours.
